title: Juicy Zesty Australian Eggplant Wrap
description: A light, adventurous wrap featuring grilled eggplant, fresh cucumber, and avocado, wrapped in banana leaf for a zesty Aussie twist.
instructions: Preheat a grill or griddle to medium-high.
Toss eggplant, bell pepper, and onion with olive oil, salt, pepper, and garlic; grill until tender and charred, about 8 minutes.
Remove from heat and let cool slightly.
In a bowl, mix lime juice, cucumber, avocado, cilantro, and a pinch of salt.
Lay a banana leaf on a flat surface and place a slice of grilled vegetable mixture in the center.
Spoon the cucumber‑avocado mixture over the vegetables.
Fold the sides of the banana leaf over the filling, then roll into a tight wrap.
Secure the wrap with a small piece of banana leaf or kitchen twine.
Warm the finished wrap on the grill for 2 minutes to seal the edges.
Serve immediately, optionally with a squeeze of lime on top.
